# LAB-Z Arcade - Copilot Instructions

## Project
- Premium browser gaming platform. Games run in the browser, free hosting only.

## Technology
- Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No frameworks unless I ask.
- Use Canvas for 2D games. Use Phaser only if I approve it.
- Keep dependencies minimal. Plan for future Supabase use.

## Coding
- Inspect existing files first. Edit them, don't rewrite them.
- Never delete working features without permission.
- Validate input and handle errors.
- Never put API keys, passwords or secrets in code or Git.

## Design
- Dark premium look, neon accents, CSS variables, responsive layouts.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Keep keyboard accessibility.

## Performance
- Target 8 GB RAM and integrated graphics.
- Avoid heavy libraries. Clean up listeners and animation loops.

## Games
- Must be really playable, with instructions, pause, restart and game over.
- Never pretend unfinished games work.

## Git
- No destructive Git commands without permission.
- Never commit node_modules, secrets or temp files.

## Testing
- Test what you build. Don't claim untested things work.
- List what you tested and what stays untested.

## Workflow
- Do only the stage I ask for. Don't jump ahead.
- Explain which files you created or changed.
